name: Mombasa Open 2024

venue.name: Shree Ramdev Peer Temple
venue.address: Shree Ramdev Peer Temple, Nyali, Mombasa

information: Welcome! This will be the first ever WCA competition in Mombasa! If this is your first time competing, please ensure to bring an ID (card, passport, birth certificate) that reflects your name, date of birth, and nationality. This competition will be taking place inside a Hindu Temple. **Please read all the tabs.** **Photos and videos are taken in the competition venue.**
